Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and metal and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Metal and Plastic. Colour: Green. Stated size: 180 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive green artificial Christmas tree designed to create a striking focal point for your home holiday display.
Constructed from durable metal and plastic materials to ensure a defined appearance and long-lasting decorative use.
Stands at a substantial 180 cm height, providing a prominent presence suitable for coordinating with other seasonal accents.
Simple and elegant design allows it to blend seamlessly into various interior styles while marking the festive occasion.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Table top
Assembly required
With stand

7984722962590.sourceDescription:
Celebrate Christmas with pastel macaron tones with this dreamy holiday tree.Boasting a soft pastel palette that departs from conventional deep green evergreens, this artificial fir offers whimsical romantic charm throughout your space. Loaded with 358 lush branch tips and vibrant PVC foliage, it forms a naturally full rounded silhouette; simply fluff the twigs to reveal rich dimensional texture. Pre-lit with 140 warm white LED bulbs and powered by a UKCA certified adapter, it casts steady soft illumination that highlights the pastel foliage and fills your space with immersive festive warmth. Featuring a 2-section hinged frame and folding metal stand, the tree sets up quickly, and included gloves protect your hands while shaping branches. Constructed from 100% new PVC material, this 4.5 ft tree maintains its beautiful appearance season after year, with flame-retardant, anti-fading, non-allergic and smell-free properties for worry-free indoor holiday decorating. Note: Ornaments are not included.
Folding metal stand ensures convenient storage
2-section structure for easy setup
140warm white LED lights for soft festive radiance
Hinged branches automatically spread out to the designated space
Color: Burgundy/Ice Blue/Lime Green/Lavender/Peacock Blue/Pink/Purple
Material: PVC, Metal
Product Dimensions: 76 x 137 cm (Dia. x H)
Tree Height: 4.5 ft/137 cm
Tree Width: 2.5 ft/76 cm
Diameter of Stand: 16"/40 cm
Number of Branch Tips: 358
Number of LED Lights: 140
Number of Sections: 2
Power Cord Length: 150 cm
Net Weight: 3 kg
PackageIncludes:
1 x Christmas Tree
1 x Pair of Gloves
1 x User Guide
Guarantee - 6 months

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Christmas Tree Topper
This Christmas tree topper adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and iron construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

8635560241390.baseName: 1 Pack 56 x 32 cm Christmas Tree Topper Bow, Velvet Hanging Decoration, Burgundy
8635560241390.variantName: 1 Pack 56 x 32 cm Christmas Tree Topper Bow, Velvet Hanging Decoration, Burgundy
8635560241390.sourceDescription:
A large burgundy velvet bow that finishes the top of a tree, dresses a door or adds the last layer to a party backdrop, with enough size to be seen and enough structure to keep its shape.

The bow measures about 56 cm long and 32 cm wide. It is made from a firm polyester velvet that holds its loops rather than sagging after a day on the tree, which is the usual problem with soft ribbon bows. The rich burgundy tone sits well with gold, cream and green decorations and looks warm under warm white lights.

A hanging rope on the back means it can be tied to a tree top, a wreath, a curtain pole, a mirror or the back of a chair without any fittings. That makes it a flexible piece: use it as a tree topper in December, then move it to a door or a party wall for a birthday or wedding, and it still looks appropriate.

The colour is dyed to resist fading, so the bow stays deep and even rather than washing out in a sunny window. The stitching is neat and the edges are finished, so no raw ribbon ends show when the tails hang free.

For the best look, arrange the loops by hand when it comes out of the packaging, then let the tails fall naturally rather than pressing them flat. Store it in a bag or box with the loops loosely filled so it comes out ready to hang next year.

Because the shape is generous, the bow reads as a deliberate decoration rather than a small trim, and it can draw the eye to a plain wall or a bare door. The velvet has a short pile that does not shed onto clothes or furniture. If the tails are too long for a shelf, loop and pin them behind the bow, or leave them hanging for a fuller look on a tall tree. Store it flat rather than hanging in a bag so the loops are not stretched out of shape.

Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use. One pack contains one large velvet bow.
56 x 32 cm Statement Size: Large enough to top a full tree or dress a door, with proportions that stay visible rather than shrinking into the foliage
Firm Velvet Structure: A stiffer velvet weave holds the loops upright instead of sagging after a day, so the bow keeps a clean shape all season
Hanging Rope Fitted: A ready made loop on the back ties to a tree top, wreath, curtain pole, mirror or chair back with no tools or fittings
Fade Resistant Burgundy: The deep tone is dyed to hold its colour in daylight and sits well with gold, cream and green decorations
Reusable and Versatile: Neat stitching and finished edges mean it moves from tree topper to door, backdrop or party wall and stores flat for next year
For Indoor Use
Shatterproof

The tree skirt itself measures 100cm in diameter, and will attach into the perfect round circle thanks to the hook and loop fastening that connects the unit together. Once the festive season is over and it’s time to take down the tree you can simply fold the tree skirt flat and put it away with the rest of your Christmas decorations, ready to be used again next year. The beautiful white colour of this Christmas tree skirt makes it look like you have a wonderful smattering of snow at the base of your tree, something that will both amaze children, and please adults, as it gives a very sophisticated look and finish to trees that are the central focal point of your living rooms, conservatories, or even office spaces.

Brighten up your home this Christmas with this shimmering 3D Star Light! Measuring 35cm x 35cm, it stands out among other decorations with its vibrant lights and pointed design. This combines with the 3D design to make a festive light that shines in different colours from different angles. Setting up the star is easy, as it features an attached hanging wire with a metal loop, allowing it to appear as if it’s floating in the air when hung. It is also powered by 3x AA batteries (not included), meaning no wiring is needed. The lights shine for 6 hours before being turned off for 18 hours to save battery life, thanks to the timer function, and should be used indoors only.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Quantity: 1 set.
Festive Christmas wreath designed to add a decorative focal point to your home or door display.
Versatile decoration suitable for coordinating with existing room colours and textures for a cohesive look.
Single set quantity allows for easy placement as a standalone feature or part of a coordinated group.
Simple design enables flexible styling around occasions, requiring minimal adjustment to refresh the display.
Comes with 1x Christmas Wreath

5096042275990.baseName: Patchwork Christmas wreath kit - Wreath making kit - Father Christmas patchwork for seasonal door or wall decorations - 31 cm
5096042275990.variantName: Patchwork Christmas wreath kit - Wreath making kit - Father Christmas patchwork for seasonal door or wall decorations - 31 cm
5096042275990.sourceDescription:
Pre-cut and pre-punched fabric pieces help you build a colourful Father Christmas decoration. With the shapes prepared, you can concentrate on arranging the layers and watching the character come together on the wreath. At 31 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

Patchwork brings together the softness of the cloth and the definition of a picture. Each section contributes to a larger shape, so progress is visible as you go and the finished decoration retains the small variations of handwork. The prepared shapes make it easier to compare adjoining pieces before fixing them. Lay out a small group at a time, keeping the rest together so that similarly coloured pieces remain easy to identify.

Begin with the broad shapes and keep the smaller details together until you reach their place in the design. Seeing the outline develop first makes it easier to judge how the finished piece will look on a wall. Before putting the decoration away, let the textile layers settle into their natural positions. Support the shape from below when lifting it and allow enough space above the fabric to keep its raised appearance.

Set out the pieces on a clear table where you can see the whole design. Group similar colours before you start and keep the next few pieces within reach, so you can follow the pattern without having to search through the materials. The project lends itself to several short sessions in the run-up to Christmas. Keep the unfinished work flat with the remaining pieces grouped beside it so that it is easy to see where to begin next time.

A wall beside a reading chair or a spot in the hall gives people a chance to see the handwork close up. Leave some space around the edge so that the pattern is easy to follow from the first detail to the last.
Pre-cut and pre-punched fabric pieces simplify the assembly of this Father Christmas patchwork wreath.
Compact 31 cm diameter size allows for easy placement on doors or walls without occupying excessive space.
Patchwork design combines soft textile layers with clear definition, retaining charming handcrafted variations.
Ideal seasonal DIY project suitable for short crafting sessions in preparation for Christmas decorations.
Comes with Pre-cut and pre-punched fabric pieces for Father Christmas patchwork design.

 This all‑season artificial green wreath is crafted with mixed eucalyptus leaves, boxwood foliage, multi‑tone berries and tiny white clustered flowers.

This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Milliput Standard Epoxy Putty 113g is designed for dependable repairs, restoration and creative work across a range of materials. This 2 part epoxy putty cures to a hard, durable finish that can be shaped, sanded, drilled or painted after setting.

Product Overview
This standard epoxy putty is ideal for repairing, rebuilding and filling damaged materials around the home, workshop or studio. Once mixed, it forms a firm compound that sets hard and can be sanded, carved, drilled or painted after curing.

Key Features

– 2 part epoxy putty for strong and durable repairs
– Suitable for wood, metal, plastic and ceramic
– Can be shaped, sanded, drilled and painted after curing
– Ideal for repair, restoration and general DIY use
– Yellow Grey finish suits a wide range of practical applications

Specifications

– Brand: Milliput
– Product Type: Epoxy Putty
– Weight: 113g
– Colour: Yellow Grey
– System: 2 part epoxy filler
– Application: Repair, filling, rebuilding and restoration

Ideal For

– Household repairs and restoration work
– Filling cracks, chips and damaged areas
– Repairing wood, metal, plastic and ceramic surfaces
– DIY, craft and hobby projects
– General maintenance and rebuilding tasks


Why Choose this Milliput Standard Epoxy Putty

Milliput is widely trusted for strong, versatile epoxy repair solutions. This product offers dependable performance, good workability and a durable cured finish, making it a practical choice for repair, restoration, modelling and creative applications.

Particularly practical: The plug-in mechanism allows for effortless assembly of the Christmas tree with just a few simple steps, without the need for additional tools. You don't have to worry about falling needles or watering, as the artificial Christmas tree always remains in splendid form.
